footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Jan 31, 2026 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 30.8% to $702M in fiscal 2026 (ended Jan 31, 2026). Gross margin was 71.3%, versus 68.4% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $197M from $108M.
The net loss widened to $398M, or −$4.07 per share, from $181M. Operating cash flow was $33.7M and free cash flow $32.8M, versus −$51.4M.
sources: Navan, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2026 (SEC EDGAR)
